title: [GMCP 203.035.05] Interoperability and quality: Official MCP Registry discovery, validation, and publication
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-035-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: GMCP consumes the official Registry API and server.json format with pagination, filters, versions, package and remote endpoints, repository metadata, caching, mirrors and offline snapshots; validates entries before trust; and can lint and publish owned servers through authenticated workflows. Yank, deletion, namespace verification, malicious metadata, stale mirrors and registry outage behavior are deterministic and provenance-preserving. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
